content.short: Karak is a universal restaking network and L2 on Ethereum that supports a wide range of assets including stablecoins.
content.description: Karak is a universal restaking protocol and EVM-compatible Layer 2 network on Ethereum, providing pooled security for decentralized applications. Unlike traditional restaking, Karak supports a diverse array of assets beyond ETH, including stablecoins and LSTs. This flexibility enables a more inclusive and robust security model for projects. Developers can leverage Karak's Distributed Secure Services (DSS) to launch oracles and bridges without building validator sets from scratch, significantly lowering costs and fostering an interconnected, reward-bearing ecosystem.
content.meta: Karak provides universal restaking and pooled security for digital assets on Ethereum. Discover Karak and other Blockchains on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
